rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:15 as anti-flood water in the base tray, told the customer to isolate power and water, warned that drying the tray is not a repair, and hedged the internal-leak cause appropriately ('such as a sump hose, pump seal or internal hose') before escalating to an engineer. Weaknesses: the first reply says 'check the door seal and spray arms as above' when nothing had been said above, the spray-arm and under-sink hose checks are of marginal relevance to water in the base tray and were somewhat belaboured across turns, and it kept the customer busy with low-yield checks when the recurring E:15 plus visible water already pointed to an engineer. No fabrication, no unsupported part, and the final direction (water off, book engineer to pull the unit) matches ground truth.
